Term1: Hernia repair surgery with abdominal mesh prophylaxis
Text:
HERNIA REPAIR SURGERY
Surgical prophylaxis is recommended for hernioplasty and herniorrhaphy.  For patients known to be colonized with MRSA, add a single dose of vancomycin to the preferred agent (cefazolin).

Antimicrobials are not indicated after incisions are closed.

References:

- Bratzler DW, et al.  Clinical practice guidelines for antimicrobial prophylaxis in surgery, Am J Health-Syst Pharm. 2013 vol 70 pages 195-283
Therapy:
## Preferred prophylaxis

Cefazolin 2 gm IV over 30 minutes beginning 60 minutes before incision ($) [R]

## For patients colonized with MRSA *ADD* Vancomycin in addition to cefazolin:

[Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV beginning 120 minutes before incision \($\) R](surg-vancomycin-weight-based-dosing)

## Alternative for patient with beta lactam allergy

[Click here] Beta-lactam reaction assessment
